owner_tests.name: test_an_UNDECODABLE_lifecycle_log_reaches_a_terminal_receipt
owner_tests.observation_reason: the lifecycle log at <TMP>/sup_entry_g02ukelp/lifecycle.jsonl is not valid UTF-8 (invalid start byte at byte 0 of 19); it is REFUSED and retained, not decoded with replacements, because a replaced byte is not the byte the producer wrote

scope: Five newly added owner test methods and four missing-field actual-main witnesses; no unchanged suite rerun.
isolation: Fake launcher, HTTP, signals and actual-main time; independent external Popen/socket/system/signal guards. One real quiet local os.pipe pair with 0.4-second drain deadline was explicitly authorized. Temporary artifacts were closed and inspected before cleanup.

fixture_transformations.base: Owner setUp uses pinned saved smoke+launch manifest, fake launcher/model/two library bytes, host/boot values from pinned smoke and a zero-failure seal.
fixture_transformations.counterexamples: Individually delete request.temperature, host_id, boot_id or patch_sha256 from that otherwise usable manifest; no other modifications.

accepted_subset: Empty object schema refusal persists one terminal receipt before launch.
The three named port/max_tokens/server_args domain errors persist a refusal.
Invalid UTF-8 lifecycle bytes reach refusal and raw-byte retention.
A deadline elapsed at barrier prevents both POSTs.
Nonblocking descriptor drain exits the tested quiet pipe at its bounded deadline.
remaining_contract: Validation does not cover all actual dereferences. Four valid-JSON missing-field cases escape with KeyError and no terminal receipt, one before cleanup. Existing artifact/source binding and remaining acquisition-plan deadline agreement are separate root-owned work, not closed by these tests.

deadline_source_inspection.claim_limit: These exact call sites and one quiet descriptor witness are checked; no blanket 600-second elapsed-time guarantee or additional boundary sweep was tested.
